en.headline: Cultural Centre moonlit lanterns stay lit until Sunday
en.dek: The Leisure and Cultural Services Department's Moonlit Bunny Crew installation at the Cultural Centre Piazza runs until 11 October.
body: A Mid-Autumn lighting installation at the Hong Kong Cultural Centre Piazza in Tsim Sha Tsui remains on show until Sunday, 11 October, the Leisure and Cultural Services Department said.

The department said the work, titled Moonlit Bunny Crew, was created by the local team STICKYLINE. It uses geometric shapes to depict landmarks of the district, with rabbit figures carrying cameras through the design. The installation has been lit at the piazza since 17 September.

Lighting hours are 6.30pm to 11pm each day, the department said. On Mid-Autumn Day, 25 September, the lights stayed on until midnight. The display is separate from the Victoria Park lantern carnival, which the department had scheduled to end on 27 September before a later extension of that Causeway Bay event.
The Cultural Centre faces Salisbury Road. The department said further details were available through its Mid-Autumn programme line on 2591 1340.

zh.headline: 文化中心月下兔燈飾亮至周日
zh.dek: 康文署在香港文化中心廣場的「月下兔仔團」燈飾裝置展至10月11日，每晚六時半至十一時亮燈。
body: 康樂及文化事務署表示，尖沙咀香港文化中心廣場的中秋燈飾裝置會展至周日，即10月11日。
署方指，這組名為「月下兔仔團」的裝置由本地創作團隊STICKYLINE製作，以簡潔幾何圖形呈現區內地標，設計中的兔子拿着相機，捕捉城市片刻。裝置由9月17日起在廣場亮燈。
康文署稱，燈飾每日下午六時半至晚上十一時亮着；中秋當日（9月25日）則延長至午夜。這組裝置與維多利亞公園的綵燈會分開舉行。署方原先安排維園活動至9月27日，其後銅鑼灣場地另有延長。
文化中心面向梳士巴利道。署方表示，市民可致電2591 1340查詢中秋節目詳情。
